sentences.en: We have to bring our teaching methods up to date.
sentences.zh: 我们必须让教学方法与时俱进。

sentences.en: In the last analysis, methods don't educate children; people do.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，是人而不是方法在教育孩子。

sentences.en: Our high school decides to adopt a new teaching method.
sentences.zh: 我们高中决定采用一种新的教学方法。

senses.zh: 使用体验派表演方法的
